dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, thin white boundaries on the outer edges of dark folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct, linear boundary where the solid dark grey crown/nape meets the high-contrast scalloped pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely repetitive and high-contrast white scalloping on the fringes of almost all dorsal feathers, creating a uniform fish-scale texture.
